cohort: Fetuses born at Showa University Hospital between 2011 and 2017, excluding those with hypercoiled cord (n=3947)
finding: The study found that hypocoiled cord is associated with non-reassuring fetal status and emergency cesarean section but is not associated with any maternal factors.
mod_finding: Hypocoiled umbilical cord was associated with an increased rate of emergency cesarean section.
